facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transformation and Administrative Modernization presented a World Bank-financed (WARDIP) national digital addressing system on 29 September 2026, with a pilot expected by end-2026 and postal code zoning and the addressing method still to be finalised, according to Ecofin Agency.

systems.platform: mapping portal, address management portal and mobile applications (planned)
systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Administrative Modernization
